body.cap: In CES 2023, AFT demonstrated its plant-based protein technology through a delicate snack out of the soft serve ice cream machine. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Armored Fresh Technologies (AFT) participated in CES 2023, held in Las Vegas, USA, for four days between January 5th (Thurs) and 8th (Sun, local time). AFT handed out ice cream made with its plant-based emulsifying protein in its booth (Booth #53314 Tech West, Venetian Expo, Level 2, Halls A-D). This dessert sample demonstrated its technology that produces alternative proteins replicating casein - a milk protein ingredient only found in animal milk. The company has applied its alternative protein to plant-based materials to generate plant-based emulsifying proteins.

AFT is creating materials and technologies to change food culture for sustainability, one of the most crucial factors in the future. Currently, the company is focusing on the technological approach that reproduces casein protein alternatives. It anticipates developing a casein protein alternative with water and oxygen.

body.cap: Booth of AFT located in the Tech West at The Venetian Expo | Photo by AVING News

body.x: After establishing the American subsidiary in New York City, the company attracted a seed investment of $1 million from Forward Deployed VC, known for funding successful IPO companies like Palantir and Lyft. AFT plans to accelerate the development of its technologies with this backing. Now, AFT focuses on 100% plant-based raw materials that can function like and replace animal protein. AFT has applied for a patent in the USA to safe-keep this plant-based protein technology.

“We are close to changes that we have never faced before, such as what we will eat in the future," Chief Technology Officer (CTO) in AFT said. "That is why we are happy to introduce a plant-based emulsified protein without animal or GMO material. In particular, this raw material is easy to apply to all dairy products such as ice cream, cheese, yogurt, and powdered formula, so we expect it to be an opportunity to collaborate with leading global companies seeking transformation.”

Section of AFT's booth with an introduction to its technology | Photo by AVING News

body.x: According to AFT, this non-GMO casein replacement underlines the possibility of substitutes for all kinds of animal dairy products - such as cheese, ice cream, and yogurt - on Mars by using only oxygen and water. In particular, the emulsified protein differs from existing plant-based proteins in function and nutrition as it is water-soluble, emulsified, non-GMO, and contains more than 50% of essential amino acids. It also can maintain the flavor profile when applied as the material has little taste. The key is to extract proteins from selected microorganisms and give those microorganisms emulsification functions so that they produce casein replacement protein.

body.cap: An attendee enjoying the plant-based ice cream from AFT | Photo by AVING News

body.x: In simpler terms, AFT aims to produce non-animal materials that can function on the same level as animal proteins, which can apply to all products containing animal proteins. AFT is developing raw materials to replace animal proteins by producing alternative proteins for casein and expanding its scope by introducing plant-based vitamins, minerals, and functional proteins.
